title: Ricotta and crushed raspberries on toast

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Ricotta, almonds, honey, bread, lemon, mint and raspberries are all plain whole foods with nothing factory-made.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is a standard Tesco line, and two punnets of raspberries in June is an everyday buy.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a frying pan, a toaster, a bowl and a fork, and the techniques are simple.

works.reason: The 250g of ricotta and 300g of raspberries over 8 slices of toast gives a sensible breakfast for four, with lemon and honey to balance it.

honest_times.reason: Toasting and chopping the almonds, crushing the fruit and toasting the bread fits believably into 10 minutes of prep and 5 of cooking.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed item, including the lemon zest and juice and the torn mint, is used in the steps, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: Fresh raspberries are the centre of a light June breakfast.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: Wholemeal toast with ricotta, fruit and nuts is a real, filling breakfast with only a spoon of honey.
